title: Persuasiveness and Bias in LLM: Investigating the Impact of Persuasiveness and Reinforcement of Bias in Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes religion as a primary category for its bias reinforcement benchmarking. It utilizes datasets (ToxicBias) to evaluate LLM responses targeting religious affiliations and includes a detailed case study (Section 2.2 and Appendix A.2) that analyzes model performance when processing theological arguments and scriptural exegesis.
